newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Air stake held bv FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Air stake held bv FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Thursday it holds a 12.61 percent stake in Alaska Air Group Inc or 1,823,800 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 82,700 common shares bought between Dec 16, 1996, and Feb 14 at $20.75 to $24.0615 per share.
FMR Corp is the parent of Fidelity Management & Research Co, investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
Alaska Air, based in Seattle, Wash., is a holding company whose subsidiaries provide air transport for passengers, property and mail.
